The '''Azure Overlook''' was a tourist spot located in [[Quantill City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]. It was a popular attraction in the [[City/Legends|city]] located in a [[Quara/Legends|Quara]] neighborhood. The Overlook was a rock garden six hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above the ocean.<ref name="Journal">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref>
